title.justification: The title 'Hierarchical Importance Weighted Autoencoders' is explicitly stated multiple times in the paper, including at the start and throughout various sections.

analysis.description: This paper introduces the Hierarchical Importance Weighted Autoencoder (H-IWAE), which is a hierarchical model designed to improve approximate inference by inducing dependencies in samples, thus reducing variance in importance weighted estimates. The authors provide both theoretical analysis and empirical evidence showing that these hierarchical structures can improve estimator performance by leveraging negative correlations between samples.

type.justification: The paper provides a theoretical analysis of the convergence of the variance of the estimator variance in connection with the lower bound and proposes theoretical contributions such as the hierarchical importance weighted lower bound (H-IWLB).
type.quote: Theoretically, we analyze the condition under which convergence of the estimator variance can be connected to convergence of the lower bound.

name.justification: The primary focus of the paper is on advancing variational inference techniques by proposing new lower bounds and evaluating them.
name.quote: We propose a hierarchical model to induce dependency among the samples for approximate inference, and derive a hierarchical importance weighted lower bound.

name.justification: The paper extends the Importance Weighted Autoencoders (IWAE) by introducing hierarchical structures to them, thus emphasizing autoencoder-related research.
name.quote: This is known as the Variational Autoencoder (VAE).

name.justification: The paper heavily focuses on Monte Carlo estimation, particularly variance reduction in importance sampling through hierarchical structures.
name.quote: To analyze the latter effect, we look at the variance of the Monte Carlo estimate of the lower bound, and show that maximizing the lower bound implicitly reduces the variance.

name.justification: The model H-IWAE is introduced in the paper as a main contribution, which builds on the Importance Weighted Autoencoder by adding hierarchical sampling.
name.quote: ...we propose to construct a joint sampler...which we call the Hierarchical Importance Weighted Autoencoder (H-IWAE).

is_contributed.justification: The paper introduces H-IWAE as a novel contribution to the field, aiming to improve inference performance.
is_contributed.quote: Our main contributions are as follows: • We propose a hierarchical model...

is_executed.justification: The paper involves empirical validation of the proposed models, implying their execution during experiments.
is_executed.quote: Empirically, we confirm that maximization of the lower bound does implicitly minimize variance.

is_compared.justification: H-IWAE is empirically compared to standard models such as IWAE in the experiments section of the paper.
is_compared.quote: We compare with Gaussian IWAE as a baseline.

referenced_paper_title.justification: The foundational model IWAE is referenced as part of this paper's background and extensions.
referenced_paper_title.quote: Burda et al. (2015) devises a new family of lower bounds with progressively smaller gap using multiple i.i.d. samples...which they call the Importance Weighted Autoencoder (IWAE).
